name: Tracer Copilot
description: Natural-language schematic copilot for KiCad. Prompt-driven circuit generation with auto-clearance placement, ERC verification, and one-click injection.
description_full: Tracer sits alongside KiCad as a floating overlay panel that snaps to your editor window. Describe the circuit you want in plain English; Tracer picks parts, values, and topology, verifies the geometry, and injects the result into your open .kicad_sch. Auto-detects the currently-open schematic; no target picker.
